Retrieve expenditure by funding source

Source: R/datasets.R
senace_gastos_fuente.Rd

Downloads budget expenditure summarized by funding source or retrieves its bundled local snapshot.

Usage

senace_gastos_fuente(api_key = NULL, offline = FALSE)

Arguments

api_key

A SENACE API key. If NULL, it is retrieved automatically.

offline

If TRUE, use the dataset bundled with the package instead of querying the API.

Value

A tibble.

Examples

senace_gastos_fuente(offline = TRUE)
#> # A tibble: 26 × 8
